row.body: A bottle of bleach sits beside a copied warning and a water bottle with its cap still sealed. The note says the caller was told to wait for instructions.
row.title: Advice by the sink

sidecar.gloss: A caller waits for instructions while household water remains untouched.
sidecar.rival_reading: The warning may concern a local chemical or sanitation problem; the sealed bottle and delayed reply do not establish the cause.
